instruction.name: xvreplve.b
instruction.description: Repeat an indexed element in each 128-bit lane.

latencies.notes: Register dependency latency. Raw measurement was 1.08; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
